name: usage-limit-guard
description: Watches Claude subscription usage limits; shows them in the status line, injects them into context, and gracefully saves/resumes work at a configurable threshold.

threshold.title: Usage threshold (%)
threshold.description: At or above this percentage the guard routine triggers (default 95).

warn_band.title: Warning band (%)
warn_band.description: At or above this percentage (but below the threshold) the status line turns amber (default 80).

threshold_five_hour.title: 5-hour window threshold (%)
threshold_five_hour.description: Override the guard threshold for the five_hour window only. Leave blank to use the global threshold.

threshold_seven_day.title: 7-day window threshold (%)
threshold_seven_day.description: Override the guard threshold for the seven_day window only. Leave blank to use the global threshold.

watch.title: Watched limit windows
watch.description: Limit windows to show/guard: 'auto' (model-aware: 5h + weekly + any per-model weekly window in use) or a comma-separated list like five_hour,seven_day,seven_day_opus (default auto).

guard_action.title: Guard action at threshold
guard_action.description: What the AI should do when the threshold is reached. Leave empty for the built-in save-and-handoff routine.

warn_action.title: Warn action at warn band
warn_action.description: Gentle advice appended to context when utilization is in the warn band (below threshold, non-blocking). Leave empty for the built-in message.

label_style.title: Label style
label_style.description: How limit window labels appear in the status line: full (e.g. 'Limit session:') or short (e.g. '5h').

reset_display.title: Reset countdown display
reset_display.description: How the reset time appears: clock (e.g. '→ 06:00'), relative (e.g. '→ in 2h13m'), or both (e.g. '→ 06:00 (in 2h13m)').

projection_display.title: Burn-rate projection
projection_display.description: Show a projected time-to-threshold segment (e.g. '📈 ~1h40m to 90%') based on recent usage trend: off or on (default off).

layout.title: Status line layout
layout.description: compact (model, context bar, limit windows, project paths) or classic (the v0.12 limits-only line). Default compact.

show_model.title: Show model
show_model.description: Show the active model name in the compact status line (default on).

show_context.title: Show context bar
show_context.description: Show a context-window usage bar in the compact status line (default on).

pace_arrow.title: Pace arrow
pace_arrow.description: Show an up arrow after a window's percentage when usage runs ahead of elapsed window time (default on).

bar_style.title: Context bar style
bar_style.description: Glyphs of the context bar: pill, block, shade, square, dot, rect, line, braille or smooth. Default pill (falls back to block in terminals without the glyphs).

background.title: Status line background
background.description: off, bar (whole line on a dark bar), tiles (every segment its own background) or warn (amber/red tile behind a limit that is in the warning band, red context). Default warn. No colors under NO_COLOR.

window_display.title: Window display
window_display.description: all (every watched window) or nearest (only the window closest to its threshold). Default all.

show_paths.title: Show project paths
show_paths.description: Show project, worktree and scratch folder segments (clickable where the terminal supports it). Default on.

scratch_dir.title: Scratch folder
scratch_dir.description: Folder shown as the scratch segment (relative to the project). Leave empty for Claude Code's built-in scratchpad.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Pop up an OS notification once when a window enters the warn band or crosses the threshold: off or on (default off).

allow_project_actions.title: Allow project-file actions
allow_project_actions.description: Let a project's .claude/limit-guard.json set guardAction, warnAction and handoff, and keep the built-in pointer to .claude/limit-guard.md. Off by default: a cloned repo could otherwise steer the assistant. Action text is capped at 500 characters.
